core_obligations: Reduce to a presentation: since the square of the covering space maps onto the square of the stack, surjectively flat and locally of finite presentation, it suffices to check the property after pulling the diagonal back along it (proof lines 1132-1145)

Identify the pullback: the pullback of the diagonal along the square of the cover is the canonical morphism from the fibre product of the cover with itself to the square of the cover (proof lines 1137-1139)

Apply the hypothesis: the two projections from that fibre product are unramified, respectively locally quasi-finite, by assumption, and the permanence statements for morphisms of algebraic spaces give the same for the canonical morphism (proof lines 1146-1155)
proof_roadmap: W × W → X × X 仍满平坦局部有限表现，故只需检验 Δ_X 沿它拉回后的性质。
该拉回恰是 W ×_X W → W × W；由假设，两支投影 pr_i: W ×_X W → W unramified（或局部拟有限）。
由代数空间层面的 unramified / 局部拟有限保持性（Morphisms of Spaces 两引理）得所求。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that if a covering algebraic space over a stack has unramified, respectively locally quasi-finite projections from its fibre product, then the diagonal of the stack has the same property (author lemma at source lines 1116-1126, label lemma-properties-covering-imply-diagonal). The proof (source lines 1128-1156) reduces the diagonal to the canonical morphism from the fibre product of the cover with itself to the square of the cover, and applies the permanence statements for morphisms of algebraic spaces to the two projections (proof lines 1132-1155). The identification of the pulled-back diagonal with that canonical morphism is the content. H3.
